event_info.event_description: Analyze for disclosures on global pandemic risks. Look for corporate language discussing widespread impacts like supply chain disruptions, labor shortages, remote work transitions, and fundamental shifts in consumer demand.

holistic_analysis: COVID-19 is presented as both an already-realized and an evolving risk for Verisk (VRSK).  Because the filing date (22-Feb-2022) is less than two years after the pandemic’s formal declaration, the Time Decay Principle permits elevated severity scores.  The disclosure shows that the pandemic triggered concrete operational responses (remote work, business-continuity plans) and measurable financial impacts (15 % of revenues exposed; slowed P&C premium growth; significant hits to consulting and credit-analytics lines).  The language mixes backward-looking facts—e.g., revenue declines beginning March 2020—with forward-looking uncertainty about “additional or unforeseen effects,” indicating that management sees the threat as persistent.  While the company stresses mitigating factors (digital delivery, subscription model covering ~85 % of revenue, covenant compliance), these do not fully offset the specific, cross-segment pressures described.  Overall, the pandemic represents a medium-to-high severity risk—material but partly buffered by Verisk’s resilient revenue mix and cloud-based operations.

evidence_list.snippet: In addition to the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and resulting global disruptions on our business and operations discussed in Item 7 of Part II, "Management's Discussion Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," and in the risk factors below, additional or unforeseen effects from the COVID-19 pandemic and the global economic climate may give rise to or amplify many of the risks discussed below.

components.reason: Acknowledges existing ‘effects of the COVID-19 pandemic’ and ‘global disruptions’.
Highlights uncertainty that future or ‘unforeseen effects’ could ‘amplify many of the risks’.
Generic, boiler-plate wording dilutes specificity.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Directly links pandemic to broad risk amplification but remains generic, yielding a moderate score of 4.

evidence_list.snippet: We have modified our operations in line with our business continuity plans due to COVID-19.

components.reason: Confirms direct operational changes driven by COVID-19.
Presence of ‘business continuity plans’ signals mitigation.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Shows real operational impact but also notes mitigation, so risk severity is low-to-moderate.

evidence_list.snippet: Of the remaining 15%, we have identified specific solutions and services, largely transactional in nature, that are being impacted by COVID-19.

components.reason: Quantifies scope of exposure (15 % of revenue).
Confirms those activities are ‘being impacted’ by COVID-19.
Impact confined to minority share of revenue, limiting severity.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Provides a concrete, quantified slice of revenue under pressure; material but not existential.

evidence_list.snippet: The primary causal factors are lower auto and travel insurance activity, the inability to enter commercial buildings to perform engineering analyses, decreased capital expenditure in the energy sector, and reduced levels of advertising by financial institutions and marketers.

components.reason: Lists multiple, specific demand-side disruptions attributable to COVID-19.
Demonstrates breadth across several customer verticals.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Detailed enumeration of pandemic-driven shocks across sectors elevates the risk score.

evidence_list.snippet: The portion of our revenue that is attributable to these solutions has been negatively impacted by COVID-19 beginning in March 2020 with the onset of the pandemic.

components.reason: Explicitly states ‘revenue … has been negatively impacted’.
Specifies timing (‘beginning in March 2020’), showing sustained effect.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Confirms duration and magnitude of direct revenue hit, warranting a mid-high score.

evidence_list.snippet: Direct premium growth slowed to 2.3% in 2020 due to COVID-19 pandemic, and premiums for personal automobile insurance actually declined.

components.reason: Provides quantitative metric (premium growth 2.3%) tied to COVID-19.
Highlights sector-specific downturn (‘premiums … declined’).

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Hard data on pandemic-induced slowdown in a core customer market pushes score to 6.

evidence_list.snippet: COVID-19 has had a significant impact on our one-time consultative revenue streams over the past year as our clients sought to temporarily reduce external expenditure while they focused on critical customer needs.

components.reason: Uses strong language ‘significant impact’ on revenue streams.
Describes direct customer behavior change causing revenue pressure.
No quantitative figure provided, slightly tempering severity.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Material but unquantified revenue impact results in a solid, but not extreme, score.

evidence_list.snippet: Additionally, governmental intervention and actions to support indebted consumers by extending credit terms has created a lag in bankruptcy and similar filings which have adversely impacted our credit analytics business, but we do believe this is a temporary impact which will reverse over time.

components.reason: Identifies adverse impact on credit analytics line caused by pandemic-related policy responses.
Management expectation that impact is ‘temporary’ mitigates risk.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Acknowledges a negative effect but labels it temporary, lowering the severity.

evidence_list.snippet: While our facilities generally remain open, we are making extensive use of the work-from-home model at this moment.

components.reason: Shows operational shift to remote work, indicating potential workforce or productivity risks.
Facilities remain open, signalling partial mitigation.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Remote-work transition is noted but largely managed, so residual risk is low.
